title: A containment graph file, graphs/<name>.json
description: The containment graph, keyed by child (graphs.md, "Containment file shape", D-604; F-148 D2): each child id maps slot name to one parent id, or to a list of parent ids for a slot whose `max` is above 1. Whether each id names an item, and each slot a slot of the child's type, is the engine's check, not the schema's.

additionalProperties.description: One child's parents: slot name to parent id, or to a list of parent ids.
